title: Milestone cadence, scope-lockdown windows, and emergency rollback runway for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Lena Morales
description: Goal: produce a single, actionable milestone cadence and a clear scope-lockdown + rollback runway tailored to the three-component release (API, Console, Runtime). Deliverables: (1) a published milestone calendar with freeze windows and owners, (2) a living cut-criteria matrix that maps severity -> allowed scope, (3) an emergency rollback runbook and Canary windows schedule, and (4) a release-notes coordination plan and templates for PM/Eng/Design/GTM.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone calendar published to shared calendar and linked in Confluence
Scope-lockdown checklist created for each freeze window with named owner and acceptance checklist
Cut-criteria matrix reviewed and approved by Eng, SRE, and Product
Rollback runbook (roles, steps, telemetry signals) drafted and validated in tabletop exercise
Release notes template and assignment roster created with deadlines and translation requirements
Canary/Gradual rollout schedule and rollback thresholds defined and configured in the Console rollout tool
rollout_matrix: Tier 0 (Critical infra fixes): allowed during freeze only with Exec sign-off; requires 2 on-call SRE approvals
Tier 1 (Bugfixes affecting >1% errors): gated; allowed during pre-freeze windows and emergency patch lane
Tier 2 (UI polish / minor enhancements): blocked during scope-lockdown; deferred to next train
Fallback path: if runtime latency regressions exceed 20% P95 after canary, automatic traffic split to previous runtime variant within 10 minutes
tasks: Draft milestone calendar and circulate to Eng/Design/SRE/GTM by 2026-02-01
Work with Runtime Eng (Marcus Chen) to define rollback procedure and required automation
Coordinate Console team to enable staged rollout controls and Canary dashboards (owner: Javier Ruiz)
Create release-notes template and mapping of feature owners to note authors
Schedule two tabletop rollback drills (dry run): one for routine rollback, one for cross-region network failure
Lock translations vendor and establish cutoff for copy changes
Prepare comms: embargoed internal notes, customer-facing blog template, and support KB updates

notes: Risk: simultaneous changes across API/Console/Runtime increase blast radius. Mitigation: stagger canaries across regions and require independent rollbacks where possible.
Decision trade-off: aggressive scope-lock reduces last-minute regressions but increases time-to-ship small fixes; adopted two-tier emergency lane for critical P0 fixes with Exec approval.
